notes: 1. Download the latest installer from the official PostgreSQL website.
2. Copy the file name (e.g. postgresql-17.6-windows-x64.exe) and replace the last lines in the url in this JSON.
3. Then open your terminal in the same folder as the exe file downloaded (Downloads).
5. Copy the SHA256 hash and replace the one in this JSON.
6. Save this and git add postgres-manifest.json
